_meta.status: HARVESTED, NOT WIRED — see `blocker` below and docs/wiki-evidence/essence-crafting.md
_meta.note: Wiki-harvested seed shard for Essence Crafting (the Cannith Crafting rename, U79). Records WHICH effects can be crafted into which item/affix slot, and WHAT MAGNITUDE each effect has at each minimum level 1-36. Verbatim from the DDO wiki.
_meta.blocker: NO SOURCE REACHABLE TO US RECORDS THE BONUS TYPE OF A CRAFTED EFFECT. The four Essence Crafting wiki tables carry zero occurrences of Enhancement/Insight/Competence/Quality/Profane/Sacred/Artifact as bonus types, and gear-planner ships no Essence Crafting pool at all. The solver buckets a contribution as (stat, bonus_type); without the type, a crafted effect either double-counts against real gear or wrongly collapses with it. Both produce a wrong number in a finished loadout, which is this project's worst output. So this shard is DATA ONLY and nothing consumes it until the type dimension is sourced.
